capabilities: Run agent CLIs in a sidebar terminal
Open and resume multiple agent tabs
Send note, folder and selection references to the agent
Start agents in folders outside the vault
Chat with Claude using an API key
extras: The node-pty native module is downloaded from the repository's releases on first use and checked by SHA-256. On mobile only the chat panel is available. Interface is in English and Turkish.
problem: Running a coding agent on vault notes means leaving Obsidian for an external terminal, with no way to hand the agent a reference to a note or selection.

relations.evidence: If ecu-terminal is installed, its copy is reused and nothing is downloaded.

requires.name: An agent CLI such as Claude Code

summary: Sidebar terminal that runs AI coding agent CLIs such as Claude Code and Codex next to your notes, with an optional Claude API chat panel.
